description: VLADA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE STATISTIČNI URAD REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by VLADA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE STATISTIČNI URAD REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE. Coverage: VLADA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE STATISTIČNI URAD REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Oskrba z vodo (1.000 m3), Slovenija, letno; Voda, dobavljena iz javnega vodovoda (1000 m3), po porečjih, Slovenija; Načrpana voda iz javnega vodovoda po vodnih virih (1000 m3), porečja, . Formats seen: HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
